subject.title: [Feature]: Add X-Actual-Model header to expose runtime model in HTTP responses

question: What actual-runtime-model contract should Gateway expose for non-streaming and streaming OpenAI-compatible HTTP responses?
rationale: Current code has selected-model metadata below the HTTP layer, but normal response headers are flushed too early for streaming fallback cases; maintainers need to choose the public API shape before implementation.

options.title: Define unified metadata contract
options.body: Document and implement one contract for non-streaming response metadata plus streaming-compatible SSE metadata across Chat Completions and Responses.

options.title: Limit to non-streaming headers
options.body: Add a header only where the selected model is known before response headers are sent, accepting that streaming clients need a separate follow-up.

options.title: Defer HTTP response metadata
options.body: Keep the work behind broader session/runtime resolved-model issues if maintainers do not want a transport-level response surface yet.

recommendation.title: Define unified metadata contract
recommendation.body: Document and implement one contract for non-streaming response metadata plus streaming-compatible SSE metadata across Chat Completions and Responses.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact Gateway API-contract gap and has the strongest recent history signal for the affected endpoint/docs surface.
